release_notes: V14.44 build 242 retains the full Leah 2R Displays product feature set while using the proven B207 Nightscout and trend-backfill foundation. It fixes the 1-hour mini-trend parser so complete Nightscout JSON objects, nested fields, date or mills timestamps and real CGM entry times are handled correctly. The long glucose trend remains one shared 12-hour RAM buffer with selectable 1-to-12-hour display slices. This build also adds a protected Web UI factory reset that erases all NVS settings only after the user types RESET, then restarts into first-time setup. Read-only Nightscout ketone history, insulin and carbohydrate history, configurable local alias, screen rotation, alarm acknowledgement, WhatsApp alerts, OTA protections, CPU-efficient trend maintenance and physical forced backfill remain active.
